title: mnemonica .tactica flow
description: Native-instance flow sites (instantiations, argument passes, property reads/writes, method calls) of one .tactica source (format version 1.0/1.1). Keys are NATIVE type names (Error, Set, ...), not mnemonica types; see tactica/README.md.

version.description: Format version. Absent means 1.0 (pre-versioning and 1.0 outputs are identical in shape).

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of generation. Informational only; readers must not require it.

flow.description: One entry array per type, keyed by name (native types like Error/Map and, where generators emit them, mnemonica dotted paths). A type with no discovered sites has no key.

location.description: `file:line:col`, 1-based, relative to the project root — see tactica/README.md "location".

kind.description: The flow shape, as emitted by generators today: "instantiation", "passAsArg", "propertyRead", "propertyWrite", "methodCall", "spread", "return", "reassignment". Open string — readers tolerate values they do not know rather than failing.

code.description: The site as source text (may span lines). Never truncated by the generator.

context.description: Short label of the enclosing construct (e.g. "new expression", a call signature). Present on instantiation/passAsArg sites in current output; optional everywhere.

propertyName.description: The member being read/written/called. Present on propertyRead/propertyWrite/methodCall sites only.

targetType.description: The declared type the value flows into or out of, when the generator could resolve one. Optional; a generator that cannot resolve it omits the field (never null).
